title: Workshop findings
description: Structured bug/security findings. Used by labs/m4/bug-hunt.sh (claude -p --json-schema), mirrored by labs/m5-agent-sdk/*/schema.{py,ts} (SDK output_format), and deliberately the same shape as the Claude Security plugin's CLAUDE-SECURITY-RESULTS.jsonl minus cwe_id (Module 7).

service.description: Service or path that was analyzed, e.g. src/adservice

summary.description: Two or three sentences on overall state

file.description: path relative to the repository root

category.description: e.g. error-handling, concurrency, input-validation, resource-leak, security
